problem: GitHub PR delivery spent unnecessary time and runner capacity on duplicated domain checks, repeated website builds, repeated dependency downloads and local browser builds that could reuse an exact-SHA preview.
prevention: Keep one PR-scoped Required authority and cancel superseded same-PR work.
Classify affected lanes before expensive work and avoid unconditional duplicate domain checks.
Use package.json-keyed npm download caching while this repository has no lockfile; switch to lockfile-bound deterministic installs if a lockfile is introduced.
Run page/SEO artifact checks on the canonical website build rather than rebuilding.
Use the exact-SHA Netlify preview for browser checks when route-ready; local build is fallback only.
Keep expensive mutation testing on schedule/manual rather than the ordinary PR critical path.
Measure queue, execution, fan-out and cancellation metrics so recurring waste becomes an optimization obligation.
failed_approaches: Configured setup-node cache and npm ci against package-lock.json before verifying that this repository has no package-lock; RLS/Skill Projection immediately exposed the invalid assumption.
